  "states": ["WaitingForConnection", "Connected", "Authenticated", "MessageListed", "MessageRetrieved", "MessageDeleted", "SessionEnded"],

      "action": "reply +OK POP3 server ready",
      "to": "Connected"

      "event": "receive APOP",
      "action": "reply +OK maildrop has 2 messages",
      "to": "Authenticated"
    },

      "event": "receive STAT",
      "action": "reply +OK 2 320",
      "to": "MessageListed"
    },
    {
      "from": "MessageListed",
      "event": "receive LIST",
      "action": "reply +OK 2 messages",
      "to": "MessageListed"

      "action": "reply +OK 120 octets",
      "to": "MessageRetrieved"
    },
    {
      "from": "MessageRetrieved",
      "event": "receive DELE 1",
      "action": "reply +OK message 1 deleted",
      "to": "MessageDeleted"
    },
    {
      "from": "MessageDeleted",
      "event": "receive RETR 2",
      "action": "reply +OK 200 octets",
      "to": "MessageRetrieved"
    },
    {

      "event": "receive DELE 2",
      "action": "reply +OK message 2 deleted",
      "to": "MessageDeleted"
